thread:
maria: Quick RFC follow-up — proposal to add a lightweight "drift detector" in the router that tracks canary-vs-control divergence and triggers an autofallback path when drift + latency errors cross thresholds. Want feedback on telemetry surface and wiring.
maria: Sketch: delta metrics over 1m/5m windows (latency_p95, error_rate, avg_token_cost) per-variant + a monotonic drift score. If score > X and rate of failed requests > Y → route to fallback pool for that tenant.
ben: How does this interact with the existing circuit-breaker? we already have global CBs that trip on p99 latency spikes.
samir: We should keep them orthogonal: circuit-breaker handles infra-level failures, drift detector is model-output-quality + subtle perf regressions. CBs still short-circuit; drift detector triggers variant-level routing changes.
olivia: Concern: automatic fallback that routes to a cheaper model could silently degrade user experience. We need a soft-fallback mode that tags responses and an eval hook to capture examples when fallback used. Also require audit logs for each fallback decision. :eyes:
maria: Agreed. Plan: two-step fallback: 1) soft-fallback (mirror traffic + return primary but mark response metadata), 2) hard-fallback (noisy switch to alternate variant). Both decisions logged with reason + metrics snapshot.
ben: Latency cost: will router decision add extra hop / sync call to decision service? we need <1ms added. Could we keep decision local with streaming counters and periodic sync to central store?
samir: Local decision + distributed consistency. Router keeps ephemeral counters per variant and tenant. A central "drift-bus" ingests summarized deltas for historical analysis and cross-tenant signals. Decision thresholds are local but can be overridden by central policy push.
maria: Example policy YAML for per-tenant thresholds (draft):
```yaml
fallback_policy:
  mode: soft|hard
  drift_window_sec: 60
  drift_threshold: 0.15
  latency_p95_delta: 0.3
  min_requests: 50
  audit: true
```
olivia: Nice. We should add a gating flag so SRE/product can opt specific tenants into autofallback during dark-launch. And a TTL for a fallback to auto-recover after N minutes.
ben: Also add a cooldown and backoff to avoid flip-flopping: require stable window where primary is under threshold for M consecutive windows before reverting.
samir: Agreed. Also propose an override API for oncall to force-lock a tenant to primary or fallback and a read-only endpoint for auditors.
maria: Telemetry surface needed: per-variant counters (requests, failures, p50/p95/p99 latency), drift_score, fallback_events (timestamp, mode, reason, actor). We should include sample payloads when drift detected (scrubbed) for offline eval.
deploy-bot: deployment started: infra/drift-detector v0.1 → staging :rocket:
ben: Action items: - samir to prototype local counters + central summarizer - olivia to draft audit + opt-in controls - maria to write RFC PR with policy spec and upgrade path - i'll add minimal perf budget tests in router e2e
maria: Meeting to sync tomorrow 11am (calendar invite sent). Thanks all. :thumbsup:
